actions.name: idle-v1
actions.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: Guardians hand-drawn 2D anime RPG animation sprite sheet.
Input image 1: APPROVED CHARACTER IDENTITY AND COSTUME REFERENCE, preserve faithfully in every frame.
Create an animation sprite sheet, EXACTLY SIX full-body drawings arranged in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Wide 1536x1024 canvas, six equal 512x512 cells, no visible grid or labels. Transparent alpha background, NO painted checkerboard, NO scenery, NO ground shadows. Each character comfortably fits inside its own cell with at least 24px empty margin, entire ears, boots, hands and single tail visible. Constant anatomical scale approximately 390px boot-to-ear height in upright frames, same camera throughout, no perspective zoom. Plant boots at the same cell-relative baseline around y=465.
Character: exact adult wolf-woman in supplied approved concept: copper-chestnut long loose hair and small side braid, warm red-brown eyes, two wolf ears, EXACTLY ONE fluffy chestnut tail with cream tip, rust-red short shoulder cape with gold wheat brooch, cream long-sleeve blouse, fitted dark brown waistcoat, ochre and burgundy layered split skirt with cream edging, charcoal leggings, tall brown boots, one belt pouch. Preserve face, adult body proportions, colors, garment construction and accessories. Match reference clean anime linework and cel shading but simplify only tiny fabric textures for readable animation. Same costume all six frames. Human hands with five anatomically correct fingers, no weapons, no giant monster claws, no extra limbs or tails, no swapping arm identities. Facing SCREEN RIGHT in a three-quarter view; left-facing opponent is offscreen right. Draw actual anatomical pose changes, not six duplicate images. No baked VFX or slash trails; those will be rendered separately by the game.
Action: gentle seamless idle breathing cycle, NOT combat movements. Keep her poised, warm and slightly mischievous, arms naturally ready with relaxed hands near waist, knees relaxed. Boots stationary at identical x,y for all six frames, torso does NOT sway sideways or change length. Subtle breathing maximum 3px shoulder displacement, gentle hair and cape motion, single tail tip small soft sway. Frame 1 neutral breath, eyes open. Frame 2 inhale, slight lift at shoulders and gentle tail motion. Frame 3 top of inhale, eyes open. Frame 4 soft exhale, eyelids closed for ONE blink, same face and head angle. Frame 5 eyes fully open, exhale, hair settling. Frame 6 nearly frame 1 to close the loop. Head never snaps or nods. ALL drawings have identical body size.
